name: Mamaearth Onion Shampoo for Hair Growth & Loss Control 250ml | Moisturizing Gentle Scalp Cleanser with Plant Keratin | Sulfate & Paraben Free
description:
Mamaearth Onion Shampoo – 250ml
For Hair Growth & Hair Fall Control | Gentle Scalp Cleanser with Plant Keratin | Sulfate & Paraben Free

Product of: India 🇮🇳

Key Benefits:

Reduces Hair Fall: Enriched with Onion Oil that stimulates the scalp, boosts blood circulation, and promotes hair regrowth.

Makes Hair Soft & Smooth: Gentle surfactants cleanse without stripping natural oils, while Plant Keratin prevents dryness and frizz.

Strengthens Hair: Strengthens from root to tip and protects against breakage caused by frequent washing.

Safe for Chemically Treated Hair: 100% natural and safe for colored or chemically treated hair.

Natural & Toxin-Free: Free from Sulfates, Silicones, Parabens, Mineral Oil & Dyes.
